name: facebook-mcp
description: Facebook Pages MCP server for the Meta Graph API — publishing, insights, moderation, messaging
long_description: Local-first TypeScript MCP server for the Meta Graph API that lets an MCP client publish, read and moderate Facebook Pages through your own Meta developer app, with least-privilege tokens, plan-and-apply write safety and no telemetry.

tools.name: facebook_whoami
tools.description: Report the identity behind the configured token (type, validity, granted permissions, expiry) plus the server, MCP SDK and pinned Graph API version.

tools.name: facebook_list_pages
tools.description: List the Facebook Pages the operator administers (via /me/accounts): id, name, category, the granted tasks, and whether a Page token is available.

tools.name: facebook_get_page
tools.description: Fetch metadata for one Page — name, category, follower/fan counts, publish state and new-Page-experience flag.

tools.name: facebook_usage
tools.description: Report the most recent Graph rate-limit signals (X-App-Usage, X-Business-Use-Case-Usage, x-fb-ads-insights-throttle) as usage percentages, so you can back off before…

tools.name: facebook_list_posts
tools.description: List a Page's posts, one cursor page at a time.

tools.name: facebook_get_post
tools.description: Fetch ONE post by its composite id ("{page-id}_{post-id}" as returned by facebook_list_posts).

tools.name: facebook_list_reels
tools.description: List a Page's Reels via the /video_reels edge — the ONLY place Reels are readable.

tools.name: facebook_get_reactions
tools.description: Read the reactions on one post: a `totals` map per reaction type (LIKE / LOVE / CARE / HAHA / WOW / SAD / ANGRY), the overall `total`, and the list of reacting users.

tools.name: facebook_create_post
tools.description: Create a Page post: plain text, a link, a multi-link card carousel, or a multi-photo carousel.

tools.name: facebook_create_photo_post
tools.description: Publish ONE photo to a Page, optionally with a caption, as a draft, or scheduled.

tools.name: facebook_create_video_post
tools.description: Upload a video to a Page.

tools.name: facebook_create_reel
tools.description: Publish a Facebook Reel through the three-phase upload (start → transfer → finish) with an explicit video_state: PUBLISHED, DRAFT or SCHEDULED.

tools.name: facebook_update_post
tools.description: Edit a Page post the app itself created, or move it through the scheduled-post lifecycle.

tools.name: facebook_delete_post
tools.description: Permanently delete a Page post the app itself created — including a scheduled one, which is the only way to cancel it.

tools.name: facebook_list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List the Page posts that are queued to publish later, each with its publish time echoed in UTC and in Page-local time.

tools.name: facebook_get_video_status
tools.description: Poll where one video stands in Meta's pipeline: uploading, processing, ready or error.

tools.name: facebook_page_insights
tools.description: Read Graph insights for one Page in a compact flat shape: one row per metric per data point ({metric, date, value}, plus `breakdown` for by-action-type metrics) and one…

tools.name: facebook_post_insights
tools.description: Read Graph insights for one published post (post_media_view, post_clicks, post_reactions_by_type_total, video metrics, ...) in the same compact flat shape as…

tools.name: facebook_reel_insights
tools.description: Read Graph insights for one Reel from /{video-id}/video_insights — the edge Reel metrics actually live on, which facebook_post_insights cannot reach.

tools.name: facebook_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a post, photo, video or another comment, newest-first by default.

tools.name: facebook_get_comment
tools.description: Read one comment by ID, optionally with its replies, and report whether a private reply is still possible (the 7-day window).

tools.name: facebook_reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a PUBLIC reply under a comment — visible to everyone who can see the thread.

tools.name: facebook_hide_comment
tools.description: Hide or unhide up to 50 comments in one call (`hidden:true` hides, `hidden:false` restores).

tools.name: facebook_delete_comment
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete up to 50 comments.

tools.name: facebook_private_reply
tools.description: Send a private message to the author of a comment.

tools.name: facebook_block_user
tools.description: Add up to 50 PSIDs to the Page's blocked list: they can no longer comment on the Page or message it.

tools.name: facebook_unblock_user
tools.description: Remove up to 50 PSIDs from the Page's blocked list, restoring their ability to comment and message.

tools.name: facebook_list_conversations
tools.description: List Messenger conversations for a Page (platform=messenger only — never Instagram threads): id, updated_time, unread_count, message_count and the latest-message snippet.

tools.name: facebook_get_conversation
tools.description: Read one Messenger thread newest-message-first: sender, timestamp, direction and body, plus typed placeholders for images, stickers, files and shared links (attachments…

tools.name: facebook_send_message
tools.description: Send ONE plain-text PRIVATE Messenger message as the Page, as a reply inside the 24-hour standard messaging window (messaging_type=RESPONSE).

tools.name: facebook_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns under one ad account, a cursor page at a time.

tools.name: facebook_list_adsets
tools.description: List ad sets under one ad account, a cursor page at a time.

tools.name: facebook_list_ads
tools.description: List individual ads under one ad account, a cursor page at a time.

tools.name: facebook_get_ad_object
tools.description: Read one campaign, ad set or ad by id.

tools.name: facebook_ads_insights
tools.description: Read performance numbers (impressions, clicks, spend, reach, cpc, ctr) for an ad account, campaign, ad set or ad.

tools.name: facebook_ads_report_status
tools.description: Probe one async insights report run and, with fetch_results:true, read its rows once it has completed.

tools.name: facebook_update_ad_object
tools.description: Pause or resume an ads object, or change its budget.

system_token.title: System User token
system_token.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

access_token.title: User access token
access_token.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

page_token.title: Page access token
page_token.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

app_id.title: Meta app ID
app_id.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

app_secret.title: Meta app secret
app_secret.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

page_id.title: Default Page ID
page_id.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

write_mode.title: Write mode
write_mode.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

media_dir.title: Local media directory
media_dir.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

tool_packages.title: Tool packages
tool_packages.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.
